objective.text: Force immediate execution of a queueable job with dispatchSync.

difficulty.rationale: Choose immediate execution deliberately without changing the default connection.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: MarkWork implements ShouldQueue, and the default connection is asynchronous. A maintenance command must finish this particular handler before its next statement, without changing the global queue default. Which call fits?

options.rationale: A queue name is not a request to use the sync connection.

options.rationale: Zero delay makes the queued job immediately available; it does not turn background dispatch into synchronous execution.
